headline: Redlands pairs stingy defense with steady wins
dek: Redlands has conceded seventeen goals while scoring 38 across all matches, turning that balance into eleven wins, five draws, and four losses. That defensive restraint has carried Redlands to the top of the SCIAC standings even as other programs have chased higher scoring totals.
